NONE: A2 belonging to or done by a particular person or thing
自己（的），本人（的）；自己人
B1 alone
獨自，一個人
B1 mainly UK without any help
獨立地；無援地
› mainly UK If you do something in your own time, you do it at the speed at which you want to work.
不慌不忙地
› UK US on your own time during the time when you are not officially working
業餘時間，非工作時間

T not continuous: B1 [ T not continuous ] to have something that legally belongs to you

T: › [ T ] mainly US informal to defeat someone completely or be much better than him or her; to perform extremely well

example: Each neighbourhood in New York has its own characteristics.
紐約的每個居民區都有自己的特點。
I'd like to have my very own apartment.
我想有自己的公寓。
He wanted an apartment of his own.
他想要一套屬於自己的公寓。
She makes all her own clothes.
她的衣服全都是自己做的。
I'm going to be out tonight, so you'll have to make your own dinner (= prepare it yourself).
我今晚要出去，所以你要自己做飯了。
Was that your own idea or did someone suggest it to you?
那是你自己的主意還是有人給你出的主意？
You'll have to make up your own mind (= decide by yourself) what you want to do.
你想做甚麼要自己拿主意。
I'd never have believed it if I hadn't seen it with my own eyes/heard it with my own ears.
要不是親眼看到／親耳聽到此事，我怎麼也不會相信。
"Is that your mum's car?" "No, it's my own (= it belongs to me)."
「那是你媽媽的車嗎？」「不，是我自己的。」
James Joyce wrote in a style that was all his own (= that was not like that of anyone else).
詹姆斯‧喬伊斯以自己獨有的風格寫作。
We like to take care of our own (= take care of people who are members of our family, or who work for us).
我們關照自己人。
I like living on my own.
我喜歡獨自一個人生活。
You may only use company computers to access the Web in your own time.
你只能在業餘時間使用公司的電腦上網。
We own our house.
我們擁有自己的房子。
I've never owned a suit in my life.
我這輩子從沒擁有過一套西裝。
[ + (that) ] I own (that) I was not very happy with the group's decision.
我承認我對集體的決定不是很滿意。
Last time we played them, we owned them!
上次交手時，我們徹底打敗了他們！

NONE: › a product that has the name of the shop that sells it, rather than the name of the company that made it
（商店的）自家品牌，自有品牌

example: [ before noun ] own-brand cosmetics
自有品牌化妝品

NONE: › in sport, a point that a player scores by mistake against their own team
（體育比賽中的）烏龍球，無意中幫對方得分的進球
› something that you do that gives you a disadvantage and helps someone else, even if this is the opposite of what you intended
無意中讓自己吃虧的行為

example: Our team lost when we scored an own goal late in the second half.
我們隊在下半場時間過半後自擺烏龍，失掉了比賽。

NONE: C2 to admit that you have done something wrong
承認，坦白（錯誤）

example: No one has owned up to stealing the money.
沒有人承認偷了那筆錢。

NONE: › belonging to or controlled by
…（擁）有的

example: a family-owned business
家族企業
state-owned industry
國有產業

NONE: B1 someone who owns something
所有者；主人；物主

example: Are you the owner of this car?
你是這輛車的車主嗎？
We still haven't found the dog's owner.
我們還沒有找到狗的主人。

NONE: › Owner-occupied houses or apartments have been bought by the people who live in them.
（房子或公寓）自用的，自己居住的
C1 the fact that you own something
所有權；物主身份；擁有

example: Do you have any proof of ownership of/for this car?
你有證據能證明你是這輛車的車主嗎？
Rates of home ownership have remained relatively constant.
擁有住房者的比率一直保持相對穩定的情況。
